from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d

def smooth_path(arr, step_px=1.0):
    arr=np.asarray(arr,float)
    xy=arr[:,:2]
    d=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1))]
    s=np.arange(0,d[-1],step_px)
    s=np.r_[s,d[-1]]
    out=np.column_stack([np.interp(s,d,arr[:,j]) for j in range(3)])
    for j in range(3):out[:,j]=gaussian_filter1d(out[:,j],2 if j<2 else 3,mode='nearest')
    out[0]=arr[0];out[-1]=arr[-1]
    return out

def path_world(arr,practice_ref=None):
    arr=smooth_path(arr)
    if practice_ref is None:
        u,v=arr[:,0],arr[:,1]
        x=.0135925-(v+.5)*.227185/1024
        y=.1135925-(u+.5)*.227185/1024
    else:
        u0,v0,x0,y0=practice_ref
        x=x0-(arr[:,1]-v0)*.227185/1024
        y=y0-(arr[:,0]-u0)*.227185/1024
    radius=arr[:,2]
    z=.020-(radius+0.8)/2650
    z=np.clip(z,.0055,.019)
    return np.column_stack([x,y,z])

def write_path(arr,name,practice_ref=None):
    pts=path_world(arr,practice_ref)
    x0,y0,z0=pts[0]
    x1,y1,z1=pts[-1]
    move([(x0,y0,.12),(x0,y0,.05)],dt=.5,note=name+' approach')

    move([(x1,y1,z1)]*5,dt=.05,note=name+' endpoint hold')
    move([(x1,y1,.06),(x1,y1,.12)],dt=.5,note=name+' lift')
